UD-031.notes: Longitudinal tabletop boards and vertical legs; four ochre plates, dark ceramic cups, a clay bottle, silver spoons, a woven basket and three individually coloured fruit. Grey paving below.

UD-032.notes: Weathered grey-brown wood with grain along the tabletop boards and vertically on the legs; grey stone paving and dark recessed mortar below.

UD-033.notes: Grain follows the long bench boards and vertical short legs; worn timber stays separate from grey stone paving.

UD-034.notes: Horizontal barrel staves, vertically boarded end, diagonal wooden supports; four transverse iron hoops and the separate protruding middle chain; grey wall and stone floor.

UD-035.notes: Six longitudinal boards with varied aged timber tones; twelve individually measured iron nail heads. The thin stone base and gaps below z=8.3 mm stay grey.

UD-040.notes: Five-board timber ground with longitudinal grain and ten iron nail heads, measured at the higher base datum. The intact wall, including its formerly brown top row, stays cool grey masonry.
